title: fix(plugin-form): a repeater on span 'auto' takes the whole row, on the record form and /forms/NAME
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDJAbBe3iTrFcF7GZrucZ32)_

Fixes #37677

A `repeater` field with no `span` rendered one cell wide in a two-column form, on the record form and on `/forms/NAME`, though the spec's form field `span` docblock lists repeater among the types that take the whole row on `span: 'auto'`.

## Premise, measured on `main` (94843b8401)

A two-column form with a text field, a textarea and a repeater, no `span` anywhere:

| Renderer | textarea row | repeater row |
|---|---|---|
| Record Edit dialog (`ModalForm`, `columns: 2`) | `@md:col-span-2` | no span class (one cell) |
| `/forms/NAME` (`FormPage`, 2-column section) | `sm:col-span-2` | no span class (one cell) |

The contract side is right and the renderers are wrong: repeater used to reach the full row through the wide `field:grid` widget it mapped to. Since objectui#11448 it maps to `field:object`, the JSON editor that `json`, `object`, `composite` and `record` also take, and `field:object` is not on the wide list. Only the docblock's "through the `field:grid` widget" clause was stale.

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/plugin-form` (`autoLayout.ts`).** The `span: 'auto'` default (`isWideFormField`) also reads the OBJECT field's type off `FormField.field`, through a new `WIDE_DECLARED_FIELD_TYPES = {repeater}`. The same set is matched on `FormField.type` too, for the caller that passes raw object-field types (app-shell's `ObjectFormDesigner`). Neither `repeater` nor `field:object` joins `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`: `isWideFieldType` is the type-only answer app-shell's `richtextSurfaceParity` test holds equal to plugin-detail's.
- **`@object-ui/console` (`FormPage.tsx`).** The named-form page now passes the object field's `type` beside its `multiple` into `resolveColSpan`, so both renderers read the same declaration.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` (`ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`).** The Studio form designer canvas now asks the form's own `span: 'auto'` default (`resolveColSpan`, with the widget id as `type` and the raw type in the stash) instead of `isWideFieldType` on the widget id, so it lays a repeater out across the row as the runtime form does (contract review S1). Every other type answers as before: the stash carries no `multiple`.
- **`@objectstack/spec` (`view.zod.ts`, describe only).** The `span` describe now says repeater is wide "by its object-field type: the JSON editor it maps to is shared with json, composite and record, which stay one cell". `liveness/view.json` row `form.sections` carries the re-read; `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` regenerated.

## Decisions made here

- **Width by declaration, not by widget id.** Adding `field:object` to the wide list would also widen `json`, `object`, `composite` and `record`, which the docblock does not list. The multi-file rule already reads `FormField.field` the same way.
- **Detail view not touched.** plugin-detail's own wide list has no repeater either, but the card and the docblock are about the form `span` key; the detail view's width is not part of this contract.

## Verification

- New and extended pins, red on `main` and green here (4 red with the two source files reverted):
  - `plugin-form/src/__tests__/repeaterAutoSpan-37677.test.tsx` (5): the record Edit dialog renders the repeater row `@md:col-span-2`; a `json` field on the same widget and a text field stay one cell (control); `resolveColSpan` on `field:object` is 1 alone, full with `field.type: 'repeater'`, 1 with `field.type: 'json'`; the bare designer type is wide through `resolveColSpan` while `isWideFieldType('repeater')` stays false; an authored `colSpan: 1` still wins (control).
  - `app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx`: the repeater pin ("lays a `repeater` field out the way the runtime form resolves it") now asserts `col-span-full`; a new `json` control on the same widget stays one cell. `ObjectFormDesigner.typeName-13148.test.tsx`'s catalog sweep derived its expected span from the canvas's old rule and went red on `5c42345811` (Test UI 10/16); its control now expects a repeater to span the row (fourth commit). All 12 `ObjectFormDesigner*` files: 82 green.
  - `console/src/components/FormPage.fieldSpan-37559.test.tsx` (+3): a repeater takes `sm:col-span-2`; a `json` field stays one cell; `colSpan: 1` on a repeater wins.
  - `app-shell/src/views/richtextSurfaceParity.test.tsx` (unchanged): the detail and form type-only wide sets still agree on every spec type. It went red on the first head (`bb58f2016b`, Test UI 5/16) when `repeater` sat on `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`; the second commit moves it to the declaration rule, and the test is green locally.
- `vitest` over all of `plugin-form` and every `FormPage*` test: green; plugin-form `__tests__` re-run after the second commit: 1,031 passed. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` for `plugin-form`: no errors in the changed files. `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors.
- After the review fixes (third commit): `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx`, `richtextSurfaceParity`, `repeaterAutoSpan-37677` and `autoLayout.test.ts`: 80 green; app-shell `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` clean on the designer files (with a rebuilt plugin-form dist); `eslint`: 0 errors.
- `packages/spec`: built, then `check:generated` (14 artifacts up to date) and `check:api-surface` unchanged.
- `overlap-check`: exit 0 (#37422 and #37366 share the spec files and merge cleanly).
